project.title: Wastewater activated sludge Metagenome
project.description: 16S rRNA sequences from batch experiments using activated sludge from Ann Arbor WWTP under different dissolved oxygen conditions. Experiments were performed to study the impact of dissolved oxygen concentration on pharmaceutical biotransformation and microbial community activity.

samples: Metagenome or environmental sample from Wastewater activated sludge
urban context stated at BioProject level only
